description.en: Copies an object's position and direction into an array: x, y, z and the direction around the vertical axis in degrees (only as many values as the array has, at most 4).
Receives [x, y, z, direction]; create it with 3 or 4 elements.

true once copied.
null if the object is not found, the second argument is not an array, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Walking 20 units from where the character stands (real usage, from ev42012500.nut)
